desktopOnly.title: DoU subscription
desktopOnly.appTitle: On a phone, subscribe in the app
desktopOnly.appBody: In the DoU app, go to MY › Subscription to subscribe through the App Store or Google Play.
desktopOnly.pcTitle: Subscribe on the web from a computer
desktopOnly.pcBody: Open this page in a desktop browser to subscribe with web payment. Either way, your subscription works on both your phone and your PC.

paymentWindow.title: Add a card
paymentWindow.description: This is a test payment window and takes no real card details. Pick an outcome.

common.placeholder: The {{id}} screen is on its way

list.title: Subscriptions
list.subtitle: Your current and ended subscriptions. Select one to see the details.

status.trial: Free trial until {{date}} · {{amount}} a month from {{chargeAt}}
status.cancelScheduled: In use until {{date}} · automatic payment stopped · you can undo the cancellation until then

empty.title: You have no subscription
empty.body: Subscribe to DoU Cloud to create clouds and open group chats with your friends.

detail.title: Subscription
detail.subtitle: Your plan, its status and the next payment.

trial.title: Free trial · until {{date}}
trial.body: When the trial ends, {{amount}} is charged every month from {{chargeAt}}. Cancel during the trial and you are not charged.

pastDue.title: Payment failed · {{dday}} until restriction
pastDue.body: The payment on {{failedAt}} failed. Change your payment method by {{date}} or your clouds will be restricted. Once you change the card, the overdue {{amount}} is charged right away.
pastDue.bodyWithReason: The payment on {{failedAt}} failed ({{reason}}). Change your payment method by {{date}} or your clouds will be restricted. Once you change the card, the overdue {{amount}} is charged right away.

restricted.title: Your clouds are restricted
restricted.body: The payment on {{failedAt}} did not go through, so your clouds have been unavailable since {{date}}. Pay the overdue {{amount}} to use them again right away.

cancelScheduled.title: Your subscription ends on {{date}} · {{dday}}
cancelScheduled.body: You cancelled. You can keep using it as before until it ends, and you won't be charged again.

downgradeScheduled.title: DoU Cloud {{to}} applies from {{date}}
downgradeScheduled.body_one: Until then you keep your current plan. {{amount}} is charged on {{date}}. If you have more than {{count}} cloud, choose the one to keep in the app.
downgradeScheduled.body_other: Until then you keep your current plan. {{amount}} is charged on {{date}}. If you have more than {{count}} clouds, choose the ones to keep in the app.

expired.title: Your subscription expired on {{date}}
expired.body: Your clouds are restricted. Subscribe again to pick up the clouds you had.
expired.bodyWithDeadline: Your clouds are restricted. Subscribe again by {{date}} to pick up the clouds you had.
expired.replacedTitle: Replaced by the next subscription on {{date}}
expired.replacedBody: See the subscription you use now under Subscriptions.

restored.title: Your subscription has started again
restored.body: You can carry on with the clouds you had.

bounced.title: Check your billing email
bounced.body: An email sent to {{address}} bounced. Check the address in billing info.

actions.chooseClouds: Choose clouds to keep in the app

periodCard.title: Subscription period
periodCard.line: Started {{date}} · billed on day {{day}} each month

plans.endingLine: In use until the day before {{date}}
plans.chooseNote_one: {{count}} cloud — choose the one to keep in the app
plans.chooseNote_other: {{count}} clouds — choose the ones to keep in the app

resume.title: Undo the cancellation?
resume.body: {{amount}} will be charged to {{card}} on {{date}} and your subscription continues.
resume.sameAsBefore: The next payment date and amount stay as they were.

resumeNoCard.title: No card to charge
resumeNoCard.body: The card was removed after you cancelled, so the next payment cannot be made. Add a card to undo the cancellation.

cancelChange.title: Cancel the scheduled downgrade?
cancelChange.body: You stay on DoU Cloud {{sort}} after {{date}}, and {{amount}} is charged that day. The clouds you chose to keep in the app are cleared.

cancelChangeToday.title: The change can't be cancelled today
cancelChangeToday.body: The payment that moves you to DoU Cloud {{sort}} is in progress today. Once it completes, you can upgrade again.

changePlan.title: Which plan do you want?
changePlan.description: You can move one step up or down from your current plan.
changePlan.none: There is no plan you can change to right now.

chooseClouds.title: Choose your clouds in the app
chooseClouds.body_one: In the DoU app, go to MY › Subscription to choose the {{count}} cloud to keep once you move to DoU Cloud {{sort}}.
chooseClouds.body_other: In the DoU app, go to MY › Subscription to choose the {{count}} clouds to keep once you move to DoU Cloud {{sort}}.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.subtitle: After cancelling you can keep using it as before until it ends.
cancel.nextValue: None — automatic payment stops right away

refund.title: Refunds
refund.body: Cancelling and refunds are separate. See the refund policy for when a refund applies and how to request one.

after.title: After the end date
after.body: Your clouds are restricted. Subscribe again to pick up the clouds you had.

unavailable.title: You can't cancel right now
unavailable.body: This subscription can't be cancelled in its current state. Check its status in the subscription details.

done.title: You cancelled your subscription
done.bannerBody: You won't be charged again. If you change your mind, you can undo the cancellation until it ends.
done.note: After the end date, subscribing again starts a new subscription instead of undoing the cancellation. If you removed your card after cancelling, add one first.
